# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

Only the latest published version of Syncbox receives security fixes.

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Please report vulnerabilities through [GitHub private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/Adridot/syncbox/security/advisories/new). Do not open a public issue for a suspected vulnerability.

Include the affected version, reproduction steps, impact, and any suggested mitigation. Security reports will be reviewed as soon as practical, and coordinated disclosure will be preferred when a fix is required.
